properties.description: CDC: reads cdc.scm_<table>_CT net changes (with operation flag) into ADLS landing

sqlReaderQuery.value: DECLARE @from binary(10)=sys.fn_cdc_get_min_lsn('scm_@{pipeline().parameters.tableName}'); DECLARE @to binary(10)=sys.fn_cdc_get_max_lsn(); SELECT *, sys.fn_cdc_map_lsn_to_time(__$start_lsn) AS cdc_commit_ts FROM cdc.fn_cdc_get_all_changes_scm_@{pipeline().parameters.tableName}(@from,@to,'all')
